title: Spot
description: data of: ty spot --json (where in the garden the telescope stands, and every spot known) or ty spot NAME --json (it stands at NAME from now on). Each spot has its own settings, spots/NAME.toml, and its own measured skyline.

spot.description: The spot named in config.toml's [site] spot; null when none is.

skyline_measured.description: Whether that spot's skyline has been measured (./horizon.py --trace --daylight, or a panorama).

settings.description: ty spot NAME only: the spot's settings file.

skyline_saved.description: Unix time the skyline was kept.
